heal_stages: roll plus the spell's base modifier
times (100 + element stat + spell power 98, without Power 25)/100, truncated
plus heals (49) and the spell's context modifier, no elemental fixed damage
times the caster's dealt heal multiplier (143)/100, truncated, skipped when the heal comes from damage turned to heal
capped at the target's missing life
shield_rules: 1040 = the dice; 1039 = trunc(caster max HP x pct/100); 1020 = round(caster level x pct/100); the shield absorbs after every multiplier (life damage = damage - shield, at least 0) and erosion applies only to the part that passed the shield; stacking and duration are not in the source
melee_rule: distance at the hit: melee when the caster is not the target and their cells are adjacent (0 or 1 cell), ranged otherwise; spells and weapons alike; not the spell's range
